rationale: A mouse wheel or pinch over an open overlay now resolves through the root's open overlay stack before the tree hit test, so a wheel over a dialog scrolls the dialog and a wheel outside a modal dialog reaches nothing behind it. The retained-ui-kernel touch is confined to deliver_mouse_wheel in pointer_dispatch.cpp, which asks the new read-only route_passive_pointer verb (declared beside route_press_to_active_overlay in overlay_dismissal.hpp) for its target and returns early when a modal overlay blocks the point; with no open overlay the unchanged tree hit test answers. A passive pointer never dismisses; press routing, dismissal, paint, and layout are unchanged. The overlay stack and its routing verbs are Pulp's own popover/dialog model with no counterpart framework behavior to backport, so this is recorded pulp-only.
